description: This course equips students with the theory and skills to extract business insights for strategic decision-making using spreadsheets and generative AI tools. By integrating AI, the curriculum shifts focus toward logical thinking, critical justification, and data storytelling. Through rich, real-world cases, students learn to co-pilot their analytics with AI, fostering a deeper understanding of how modern Business Analytics drives management success.
